data.long_description:
Step into luxury living with this beautifully designed 1-bedroom apartment in the prestigious Vida Dubai Mall Tower, located in the heart of Downtown Dubai. Offering direct access to Dubai Mall and breathtaking Zabeel views, this residence is ideal for those seeking modern elegance and ultimate convenience.

Apartment Features:

1 Bedroom | 2 Bathrooms
Built-Up Area: 759.72 sq.ft.
Spacious Balcony with Zabeel Views
Open-Plan Living & Dining Area
Fully Equipped Kitchen
Built-in Wardrobes
1 Designated Parking Space
Direct Access to Dubai Mall via Air-Conditioned Bridge

Tower Amenities:

Infinity Swimming Pool
State-of-the-Art Gymnasium
Beach Access
Dining Outlets & Cafés
Healthcare Centre
Children’s Play Area
Landscaped Parks & Leisure Zones
Retail Stores & Supermarket

About Vida Dubai Mall:

Developed by Emaar Properties, Vida Dubai Mall is a premium branded residence offering a blend of 1 to 4-bedroom serviced apartments. Nestled beside Sheikh Mohammed Bin Rashid Boulevard, it provides a vibrant lifestyle with uninterrupted views of Burj Khalifa and The Dubai Fountain.

Enjoy the convenience of being steps away from world-class shopping, dining, and entertainment, with excellent connectivity to Sheikh Zayed Road, Financial Centre Road, and Dubai’s major business hubs.

Experience Elevated Urban Living

From the floor-to-ceiling windows to the private balcony, every detail of this apartment is designed to deliver light-filled, elegant spaces with exceptional views. Whether for personal use or as a high-yield investment, this is Downtown living at its finest.
